basic_details.short_information: Karnataka Veterinary, Animal and Fisheries Sciences University (KVAFSU) has released the official Assistant Professor Notification 2026 at https://www.kvafsu.edu.in/. A total of 1 vacancy has been announced under the KVAFSU Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026. Eligible candidates with M.F.Sc. or Ph.D. in Aquaculture/Aquatic Environment Management can attend the walk-in interview on 30 July 2026. Candidates should refer to the official notification for age limit details. The official notification PDF and walk-in interview details are available below.

content_sections.heading: KVAFSU Assistant Professor Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the KVAFSU Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download KVAFSU Assistant Professor Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: KVAFSU Assistant Professor Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: A total of 1 vacancy is available – 1 for the Assistant Professor post.

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: M.F.Sc. / Ph.D. in Aquaculture/Aquatic Environment Management specialization preferred.

content_sections.heading: KVAFSU Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for KVAFSU Assistant Professor recruitment?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Assistant Professor position at KVAFSU is scheduled for 30th July 2026. Candidates should ensure they report to the venue on this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Assistant Professor post?
faq.answer: The required educational qualification for the Assistant Professor post is M.F.Sc. or Ph.D. in Aquaculture or Aquatic Environment Management. Specialization in these fields is preferred.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Assistant Professor position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Assistant Professor position will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 50,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee required for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this KVAFSU Assistant Professor recruitment.

faq.question: Q5. What is the mode of application for this KVAFSU recruitment?
faq.answer: The mode of application for this recruitment is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview directly at the specified venue and time.

faq.question: Q6. How many vacancies are available for the Assistant Professor post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Assistant Professor post at Karnataka Veterinary, Animal and Fisheries Sciences University (KVAFSU).

faq.question: Q7. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should carry all original documents, including ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if any), and category certificates (if applicable), along with one set of self-attested photocopies.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the walk-in interview venue?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held in Bengaluru, Karnataka. The exact address and venue details are available in the official notification.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent or contractual job?
faq.answer: This is a contractual job opportunity. The selected candidate will be appointed on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for the Assistant Professor role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Assistant Professor role involves a Walk-in Interview followed by Document Verification.
